title: Deer-Eyed Cosmic Figure
description: A surreal black and white figure with large antlers stands centrally, its head composed of multiple eyes including a third eye with a red iris containing a tiny scene of a person on a path. Smaller screaming faces emerge from its torso. In the foreground, a small grey alien-like figure walks along a geometric path through purple flowers toward the giant. The background features a starry black sky with geometric triangular patterns and red horizon glow.
prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork featuring a towering central humanoid figure with large branching antlers, its head formed from overlapping eyes with a prominent third eye containing a miniature scene of a lone figure on a path. Multiple screaming faces emerge from the torso. In the foreground a small grey alien walks a geometric triangular path through a field of purple flowers directly toward the giant. Background shows a starry black cosmic sky with intricate geometric triangular and circular patterns and a glowing red horizon, high contrast black and white line art with selective purple and red accents.
